scientific_question: Does classifier-only class-balanced retraining improve support-eligible tail metrics without unacceptable native-metric regression?

representation.name: r0_pafa_icbhi_task_encoder
representation.claim_boundary: target-supervised frozen-feature evidence; not clean source-only generalization

conditions.t0_corrected_r0_d2_reference: Corrected-HF R0 D2 shared-adapter native-head reference; read-only reuse.
conditions.t1_support_aware_classifier_retraining: Freeze each corrected R0 D2 fold-specific adapter, discard and reinitialize every final native classifier, then retrain classifiers only.

t1_training.encoder_and_adapter: frozen; adapter eval mode; dropout disabled during classifier retraining
t1_training.multiclass_binary: class-balanced replacement sampling over subtrain classes with positive support; epoch draw count equals eligible subtrain rows; unweighted cross entropy
t1_training.multilabel: each output row trained independently with 50/50 replacement from observed positives and observed negatives; epoch draw count equals task-eligible subtrain rows; unknown/not-annotated rows omitted; unweighted binary cross entropy
t1_training.selection: validation macro F1 only; multiclass per task and multilabel per output row
t1_training.inference: fixed argmax for multiclass and fixed 0.5 threshold for multilabel; no threshold search
t1_training.test_policy: outer/test predictions written label-free before terminal SPR annotation join; no test-side selection

tail_analysis.eligibility: Only labels marked primary_evaluable in the accepted contract may contribute a go vote. Diagnostic and not-evaluable labels remain reported.
tail_analysis.eligible_macro_f1: unweighted mean class F1 over primary_evaluable labels in each native task
tail_analysis.tail_label_rule: Within each task, primary-evaluable labels with accepted pre-test subtrain/full-release positive support below that task's maximum primary support are tail labels; if a task has one primary label, that label remains the tail diagnostic.
tail_analysis.tail_recall: unweighted mean recall over the preregistered tail labels
tail_analysis.go_rule: At least two primary-evaluable native tasks improve tail recall or eligible macro F1 by at least 0.03, while every task's weighted/micro F1, available native score, and available specificity regress by no more than 0.03.

reporting.folds: five KAUH-fold-conditioned models for every condition; KAUH aggregate patient OOF
reporting.metrics: all native metrics and classwise precision/recall/F1/support; no pooled cross-dataset Score
reporting.sprsound: label-free inter prediction followed by terminal scoring join
reporting.hf_lung: corrected date proxy is grouping only and never patient_id; missing/not-annotated is omitted, not negative

forbidden: new representation, loss, seed, condition, threshold or hyperparameter sweep
